import cv2, numpy as np, glob, json
cards=json.load(open('/input/input/resume_cards/cards.json'))
frames=sorted(glob.glob('/work/lowres/f*.jpg'))
F=[cv2.imread(p,cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) for p in frames]

    for ip in c['images']:
        im=cv2.imread('/input/input/resume_cards/'+ip.split('/')[-1],cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)

        for idx,f in enumerate(F):

            r=cv2.matchTemplate(f,im,cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
            scores.append(float(r.max()))

        outs.append({'img':ip,'top':[(int(i),round(scores[i],3)) for i in order], 'x':None})

import cv2, numpy as np, glob, json
cards=json.load(open('/input/input/resume_cards/cards.json'))
frames=sorted(glob.glob('/work/lowres/f*.jpg'))
F=[]
for p in frames:
    im=cv2.imread(p,0); im=cv2.resize(im,(320,180))
    F.append(cv2.Canny(im,50,120).astype(np.float32))
res={}
for c in cards['cards']:
    outs=[]
    for ip in c['images']:
        im=cv2.imread('/input/input/resume_cards/'+ip.split('/')[-1],0)
        tr=c['transform']
        if tr=='horizontal_mirror': im=cv2.flip(im,1)
        elif tr=='rotate_180': im=cv2.rotate(im,cv2.ROTATE_180)
        im=im[:, :1380]
        im=cv2.resize(im,(230,180))
        e=cv2.Canny(im,50,120).astype(np.float32)
        sc=[]
        for f in F:
            # try a few x offsets
            best=-1
            for dx in range(0,320-230+1,10):
                r=cv2.matchTemplate(f[:,dx:dx+230],e,cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED).max()
                best=max(best,float(r))
            sc.append(best)
        order=np.argsort(sc)[::-1][:8]
        outs.append({'img':ip,'top':[(int(i),round(sc[i],3)) for i in order]})
    res[c['card_id']]=outs
print(json.dumps(res,indent=1))

idx=list(range(0,3899,4))

    im=cv2.imread(f'/work/lowres/f{t+1:05d}.jpg',0)

out={}
for c in cards['cards']:
    o=[]
    for ip in c['images']:
        im=cv2.imread('/input/input/resume_cards/'+ip.split('/')[-1],0)
        tr=c['transform']
        if tr=='horizontal_mirror': im=cv2.flip(im,1)
        elif tr=='rotate_180': im=cv2.rotate(im,cv2.ROTATE_180)
        im=cv2.resize(im,(460,360))
        kp,des=orb.detectAndCompute(im,None)
        sc=[]
        for t,k2,d2 in F:
            if d2 is None: sc.append((t,0)); continue
            m=bf.match(des,d2)
            good=[x for x in m if x.distance<40]
            sc.append((t,len(good)))
        sc.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])

    out[c['card_id']]=o

import cv2, numpy as np, json, glob
cards=json.load(open('/input/input/resume_cards/cards.json'))
fr=sorted(glob.glob('/work/lowres/f*.jpg'))
FM=[]
for p in fr:
    im=cv2.imread(p)
    m=((im[:,:,2].astype(int)>90)&(im[:,:,2].astype(int)-im[:,:,1]>35)&(im[:,:,2].astype(int)-im[:,:,0]>35)).astype(np.uint8)*255
    FM.append(cv2.resize(m,(240,135)))
print('frames',len(FM))
out={}
for c in cards['cards']:
    o=[]
    for ip in c['images']:
        im=cv2.imread('/input/input/resume_cards/'+ip.split('/')[-1])
        if c['transform']=='horizontal_mirror': im=cv2.flip(im,1)
        elif c['transform']=='rotate_180': im=cv2.rotate(im,cv2.ROTATE_180)
        m=((im[:,:,2].astype(int)>90)&(im[:,:,2].astype(int)-im[:,:,1]>35)&(im[:,:,2].astype(int)-im[:,:,0]>35)).astype(np.uint8)*255
        m=cv2.resize(m,(240,135))  # full card incl right strip (paper absent there)
        sc=[]
        for i,f in enumerate(FM):
            inter=np.logical_and(f>0,m>0).sum(); uni=np.logical_or(f>0,m>0).sum()

        order=np.argsort(sc)[::-1][:10]
        o.append({'img':ip.split('/')[-1],'top':[(int(k),round(float(sc[k]),3)) for k in order]})
    out[c['card_id']]=o
print(json.dumps(out))

def ensure(t):
    p=f'/work/hi/c{t}.jpg'

        subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-ss',str(t),'-i','/input/input/tutorial.mp4','-frames:v','1','-q:v','2',p],check=True)

def mark(im, marks, dash=False):
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im); W,H=im.size
    fb=ImageFont.truetype(FB, int(H*0.048)); fr=ImageFont.truetype(FR, int(H*0.040))
    for i,(fx,fy,label,tx,ty) in enumerate(marks):
        cx,cy=fx*W,fy*H; txp,typ=tx*W,ty*H
        r=max(28,int(H*0.075))
        d.ellipse([cx-r,cy-r,cx+r,cy+r],outline=(255,215,0),width=max(4,int(H*0.008)))
        d.line([cx,cy,txp,typ],fill=(255,215,0),width=max(3,int(H*0.006)))
        tb=d.textbbox((0,0),label,font=fb); tw,th=tb[2]-tb[0],tb[3]-tb[1]
        bx=txp if txp<W*0.55 else txp-tw-16
        by=typ-th-16 if typ>H*0.25 else typ+12
        d.rectangle([bx-8,by-8,bx+tw+8,by+th+14],fill=(255,215,0))
        d.text((bx,by),label,font=fb,fill=(20,20,20))
    return im

def fig(name, t, box, w, marks=(), card=None, transform=None, src_note=''):

    im=im.resize((w, int(w*im.size[1]/im.size[0])), Image.LANCZOS)
